newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mobil Australia says refinery at full output.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Australia says refinery at full output.

text.p: Mobil Australia Ltd said on Tuesday its 108,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery in Melbourne was back at full production after workers repaired and restarted one of the plant's crude distillers late last week.
"We are back to normal (crude) intake and normal production," a Mobil spokeswoman told Reuters.
Earlier, the company had said the crude distiller would not be brought back on line until early this week.
The 65,000 bpd crude distillation unit, one of two at the refinery, had been shut down since August 13 for repair.
The unit was shut down after unexpected mechanical problems. Crude distillation is the first stage of oil refining.
Gippsland crude accounts for about half of the refinery's normal crude supplies.
